definitions.paired_only_material: Gold modified groups with both sides nonempty; predicted modified groups with both sides nonempty; exact group identity required; predictions touching ambiguous gold excluded. Additions/removals excluded.
definitions.split_merge_correspondence: Exactly recovered gold paired groups with at least one side longer than one passage, independent of predicted status. Null recall when denominator is zero.
definitions.ui_review_tasks: Current radar.presentation._review_tasks called separately for each document, then summed. Canonical raw events unchanged.
definitions.recomputation: Per-case metrics and aggregate recomputed with evaluator; paired metrics, split recall, and task counts computed separately. Source text and exact partitions checked against manifest files.
